title: Combine button sits exactly on top of the Equip button: any item you hold 3+ copies of cannot be equipped
steps: Seed a realm save with 4x Scholar Ring (r0) and a ranger or bruiser hero Lv 20
Open the Realm world, press B (or tap the backpack button)
Look at a Scholar Ring row: only 'Combine 3->Uncommon' and 'Sell' are visible
Try to click/tap Equip: elementFromPoint at the Equip button centre returns the Combine button; Playwright click on the Equip button times out (covered)
expected: Equip and Combine are separate, visible, tappable buttons
actual: Both are button.eq pinned to grid-column 2 / row 1, same rect (desktop 607,427 156x44; phone 123,539 156x44). Equip is hidden and unreachable; the player can only Combine or Sell. Rows without 3 copies (Lucky Ring) show Equip normally
suspect: game/realm-ui.css:94 (#realm-bp-list button.eq { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2 }) and game/games/mad-maze/mad-maze.css:213; the Combine button in realm.js:4604 reuses class eq

title: Desktop double-click on Sell sells TWO items: the second click lands on the next row's Sell after the re-render (lost my equipped armor)
steps: Desktop 1280x720, backpack with Quickfire Wand (Rare, uid 3) followed by the equipped T2 Iron Cuirass (uid 4)
Open backpack (B), scroll to the Quickfire Wand row
Click its 'Sell 15' button twice, ~120 ms apart (a normal double-click)
expected: One item sold (or a confirm step)
actual: Shards 500 -> 522 (15 + 7): the Quickfire Wand AND the equipped Iron Cuirass are gone, armor slot emptied, saved to storage and still gone after reload. Reproduced 2/2 (Playwright dblclick and two mouse.click). On phone a double touch-tap sold only one (1/1)
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/mad-maze.js:120-123 (data-act discard handler, no debounce) + realm.js:4214 discard() re-renders the list immediately so the next row slides under the cursor

title: Sell is one click with no confirm, even for the equipped T12 chase weapon, soulbound or relic items
steps: Backpack with equipped T12 Spark Wand (uid 1) and T12 Dread Plate relic
Click 'Sell 31' on the T12 wand row once
expected: High-value items (T7+, soulbound, relic, equipped) ask before selling, like Salvage already does ('Salvage this item for N dust?')
actual: Instantly sold for 31 shards, weapon slot emptied, saved. A T12 chase item and the relic-book Dread Plate are one stray tap from gone; Sell sits right next to Unequip/Equip. Also a T12 only sells for 31 shards (a classic Rare sells for 15), so the loss feels worse

title: Full backpack silently auto-sells a T12 drop, including an over-level T12 (spec says over-level drops are never auto-sold)
steps: Seed 24/24 items, ranger hero Lv 3 (or Lv 20)
Have a T12 bag drop next to you (a.dropBag(x,y,2,'sparkwand',{tierIndex:4},{t:12,a:555}) to simulate a boss drop)
Walk into it
expected: Per GEAR-DROPS-BUILD-PLAN.md:61 ('Over-level drops ... are never auto-sold') and NEXT-SLICES-3.md:119 ('or the bag stays on the ground'): a T12 (at least an over-level one) stays on the ground, or the player is asked
actual: Sold on the spot: Lv 3 -> +39 shards (lastFullSale {id:'sparkwand',r:2,t:12}); Lv 20 -> wpn_hammer_throw T12 sold for 31. Only feedback is a faint float text; the 'New best tier' chase never counts it
suspect: game/realm.js:3459-3466 collectItem (full pack branch ignores tier / level gate)

title: No warning that the backpack is full; the 'sold X +N' float text is unreadable on grass
steps: 24/24 items, walk over several bags in the Shore/grass area
expected: A visible 'Backpack full' cue on the HUD/backpack button before you pick up, and a readable sale message
actual: Nothing on the HUD says full (no text matches 'full' in the page). The sale text 'sold Hearty Charm +7' is small, semi-transparent, green on green grass, gone in ~1 s

title: Loot bags are tiny plain squares; a T12 bag looks like any other bag
steps: Drop bags of r0-r2 and T5/T9/T12 next to the player
Look at them in the world (zoom crop)
expected: T12 uses bag_red + bag_soulbound_sparkle (GEAR-DROPS-BUILD-PLAN.md:61); tiers readable at a glance
actual: Every bag is a ~10-14 px flat coloured square; the T12 Rare bag is a small white square, no sparkle, easy to miss on sand. (May be waiting on Codex b15 loot-bags art; then this confirms the gap)

title: 'New best tier: T12 ...' toast draws over the backpack header (covers hero name / HP bar)
steps: Pick up a T12 item
Press B within a few seconds
expected: Toast hidden or placed outside the open panel
actual: The toast sits on top of the hero name and HP bar in the backpack card

title: Stats tab keeps the red compare deltas of an item tapped on the Gear tab (looks like a debuff)
steps: Phone 390x844, open backpack, tap the T11 Spark Wand row name (not equipped) to compare
Switch to the Stats tab
expected: Stats tab shows plain totals (it says the Gear tab is where you compare)
actual: POWER 8.1 -3.9 and LUCK 6.3 -6.3 in red with 'Wearing: Spark Wand' under it; it reads like the hero is debuffed. 'Wearing: Spark Wand' is also ambiguous when both items are Spark Wands (no tier shown)

title: Phone landscape 844x390: the 'Next goal' HUD label is drawn on top of the backpack card
steps: Phone portrait, open backpack
Rotate to 844x390
expected: The open panel covers or hides HUD labels
actual: 'Next goal: Head inland to the Midlands' overlaps the HP/XP rows of the card; minimap and zone label also show beside it

title: Gear rows have inconsistent tall layouts; on desktop only ~1.5 items fit, no sort, newest loot ends at the bottom
steps: Desktop 1280x720, backpack with ~16 items incl. T11/T12 affix items
expected: Compact rows, the card uses more of the 1280 width, a way to sort (tier/new) or jump to new loot
actual: Affix rows stack name into a narrow column ('T12 Spark / Wand', rarity floating mid-row, Forge on its own line) while plain rows are one line; the card is ~470 px wide with one T12 row filling the visible list; a new T12 pickup is the 24th row under 21 rings

title: A T12 drop can be a weapon of another class family that the hero can never equip
steps: Ranger Lv 20 picks up a T12 bag
Open backpack
expected: Chase-tier drops favour the hero's family (or say who can use it)
actual: Got 'T12 Smite' (wpn_hammer_smite) shown with a disabled '🔒 Hammer' button; for a bruiser too. By design 30% of styled drops are any family, but at T12 it feels like a wasted chase drop; sell value 39 shards

title: Double-tapping 'Confirm reforge' opens the Salvage confirm for the item you just forged (one more tap destroys it)
steps: Phone 390x844, equipped T8 Spark Wand, 40 dust, 2 shards
Backpack > Forge on the wand > pick Keen (40 dust + 2)
Double-tap the Confirm reforge button (~80 ms apart)
expected: The second tap is ignored (or lands on something harmless)
actual: Reforge charged once (good: 40 dust + 2 shards, uid 30 -> 100, still equipped), but the re-rendered Forge box puts the Salvage button under the finger, so the second tap opens 'Salvage this item for 9 dust? Confirm salvage +9 dust'. A third tap would salvage the item just paid 40 dust for
